lines: Kit followed your footprints. Now she is on a frozen mountain top, and the cold things are coming *closer*.
You have one jump left. Use it to run away safe... or to bring *her* home.
You hold her hand and jump. The mountain shatters into light. And you land... in your *kitchen*.
Kit laughs. Cereal everywhere. Your sock is back on your foot. For one second, everything is *perfect*.
Then Trek takes off his cap. He is wearing... *your pyjamas* under his coat. Why?
Follow for the next story... and comment what it should be!
